SD45-CP05.name: Magnadramon
SD45-CP05.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can return one of this Spirit's Yellow "Ultimate" family pre-Advent cards to the Hand. When you've done so, during this turn, the symbols of all opposing Spirits become zero.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
By sending one of your Lives to your Trash, this Spirit refreshes.

SD45-001.name: Agumon［2］
SD45-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
If your Life is at three or less, by returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a "WarGreymon"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Red/Purple] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

SD45-013.name: Evolution Draw
SD45-013.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Also, if you control any "Mega" family Spirit, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

SD45-014.name: Evolution Shoot
SD45-014.effect:
When your "Mega" family Spirit is summoned/[advented], return this card from the Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Flash]
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

SD45-008.name: Garurumon［2］
SD45-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. When any Spirit is depleted by this effect, return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Red/Purple] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

SD45-002.name: Greymon［2］
SD45-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing Nexus, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Red/Purple] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

SD45-CP02.name: HerculesKabuterimon
SD45-CP02.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can return one of this Spirit's Green "Ultimate" family pre-Advent cards to the Hand. When you've done so, put three core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (When Attacks)
Send three cores from this Spirit to your Trash. When you've done so, exhaust an opposing Spirit, and refresh this Spirit.

SD45-004.name: Leomon［2］
SD45-004.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Warp Digivolve: Red/Purple] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

SD45-010.name: MetalGarurumon［2］
SD45-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
When your Spirit effects deplete any opposing Spirits, draw a card.

SD45-003.name: MetalGreymon［2］
SD45-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 6000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon up to one "WarGreymon"-named Spirit card and one Cost 7 "MetalGarurumon"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6988.name: Omnimon Merciful Mode
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6988.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 7 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 15000 BP. Also, you can add as many "Mega" family Spirit cards as you want from your Hand/Trash as pre-Advent cards to under this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By discarding one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, this Spirit refreshes.

SD45-006.name: Omnimon［2］
SD45-006.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Mega] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit. When you've done so, return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By discarding one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

SD45-CP01.name: Phoenixmon
SD45-CP01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

You can also stack this card from the Trash via [Advent].

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can return one of this Spirit's Red "Ultimate" family pre-Advent cards to the Hand. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or more Spirit. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

SD45-CP03.name: Rosemon
SD45-CP03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can return one of this Spirit's Green "Ultimate" family pre-Advent cards to the Hand. When you've done so, return two opposing exhausted Spirits to the decktop in any order.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opposing Burst can't activate.

SD45-CP04.name: Seraphimon
SD45-CP04.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can return one of this Spirit's Yellow "Ultimate" family pre-Advent cards to the Hand. When you've done so, during this turn, every opposing Spirit gets -10000 BP. Destroy every Spirit whose BP is brought to 0 by this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates.

SD45-011.name: The Crest of Courage
SD45-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the amount of cards you draw by +1. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand. If you control any "Greymon"-named Spirit, this effect discards -1 card from your Hand. These effects don't stack.

SD45-012.name: The Crest of Friendship
SD45-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Rookie"/"Champion"/"Ultimate" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2]
When your "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirits are destroyed, by discarding a card from your Hand, one of the destroyed Spirits remains on the Field, exhausted.

SD45-CP06.name: Vikemon
SD45-CP06.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can return one of this Spirit's Blue "Ultimate" family pre-Advent cards to the Hand. When you've done so, discard five cards from the opposing decktop. When any Magic card is discarded by this effect, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of the battle, discard seven cards from the opposing decktop.

SD45-005.name: WarGreymon［2］
SD45-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit. When this effect destroys any Spirit, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

SD45-009.name: WereGarurumon［2］
SD45-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon up to one "MetalGarurumon"-named Spirit card and one Cost 7 "WarGreymon"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
